allowances.reason: Tracked gap AUD3-11: real GCP exposes Cluster.bootstrapAddress over BOTH transports, but the pinned cloud.google.com/go/managedkafka@v1.1.0 client proto defines no such field, so the emulator's gRPC surface cannot return it (internal/gcp/transport/grpc/managedkafka/transcode.go). Tolerated by this allowance until the proto is bumped; not a state divergence (both transports share one core).
